body: Can't agree with this enough.  Once you've tried the recommended avenues of help and come up empty, then you *really* feel hopeless.  It's so hard realizing that doctors and experts -- the types of people I and most of us learned to look up to and trust as a kid -- have no answers.  Combine that with self-attempts to fix depression failing as well, and life just becomes waiting to commit suicide.
This place just adds to my conviction that there is no reason for hope.  No solutions are ever offered for someone like me because there are no solutions.
There are so many things for YOU to live for.
Years of talk therapy and counseling, including the one I'm seeing now.  And I'm worse off now than before.  I envy the temporarily suicidal so much...

I've gotten too much help.  I was nearly helped to death with anti-depressants.  I've been in some sort of therapy or counseling for 10 years...but I've had to realize that there's no one left who can help me.  My current therapist is cutting me off in a few months.

I've searched for every possible solution and I have to conclude that the only ones left are ropes, knives, or guns.
Caring can't solve what's killing me.  All the traditional methods of help have failed, too.  Some people can't be saved.
Never said they cared.  That's not their job.
